set.body:
Purpose

Establish the actual supported regime instead of promising that every local dense metric scales.

Acceptance

- A named 50-60k-feature volume fixture records support distribution, union-pair degree, persistent bytes, peak RSS above baseline, factorization work, source reads, and wall time.
- No allocation scales as p squared, m times p squared, a persistent m times k squared, or m times folds times k squared.
- Before the benchmark merges, lock a machine profile and preliminary hard budget; use 4 GiB peak incremental RSS and 30 minutes for one contrast as the initial go/no-go target unless empirical calibration justifies a stricter value.
- If dense local shrinkage misses the gate, version 0.1 supports brain-scale diagonal metrics and explicitly scopes dense metrics to smaller supports/node sets.
- Volume output maps exactly to NeuroVol indices; a surface adapter follows the same index contract.
- README claims the additive removal of repeated searchlight work only for feature-additive metrics and states the support-streamed cost for dense metrics.
- Small-node connectivity/tomography scope is enforced or those exports remain internal.
set.title: Epic 8: Qualify brain-scale execution and neuroimaging output
